ingredients.name: reduced-sodium cream of chicken soup (10.75 ounces)

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts to the skillet.
Take the chicken out of the pan and set it aside.
Stir 1 can of reduced-sodium cream of chicken soup and 1/2 cup of water in the skillet.
steps.spoken: Stir 1 can of reduced-sodium cream of chicken soup and 1/2 cup of water in the skillet. The can is 10.75 ounces.

steps.instruction: Heat the soup mixture until it boils.
Return the chicken to the skillet.
Lower the heat and simmer 10 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 165 °F.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat to low and simmer for 10 more minutes, or until a thermometer reads 165 °F in the thickest part of the chicken.

ingredients.name: fresh basil, chopped, for the mix

steps.instruction: Dice 1 ripe avocado.
Dice 2 medium tomatoes and 1 green onion.
Peel and chop 4 hard-boiled eggs.
Toss the avocado, tomatoes, onion, eggs and 1/2 cup of basil in a small bowl.
steps.spoken: Gently toss the avocado, tomatoes, green onion, eggs and 1/2 cup of basil in a small bowl. Keep 2 tablespoons of basil for garnish.

steps.instruction: Add cracked black pepper to taste.
Toast the 12 slices of baguette bread.
Smear the toast with 1/4 cup of ricotta cheese.
Top the toast with the avocado mix.
Garnish with 2 tablespoons of chopped basil.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Family Fun, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Team Nutrition

ingredients.name: whole chicken, skinned and cut into 10 pieces
lemon, sliced into 10 slices, seeds removed

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Mix 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, 1 1/2 cloves garlic and 4 teaspoons thyme.
Lay 3 1/2 pounds of chicken pieces in an 11-by-13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle the seasonings over the chicken.
In a saucepan, combine 3 cups sliced onion, 1 1/2 cups broth and 1/4 cup lemon juice.
Heat the onion mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot lemon mixture around the chicken.
Top each chicken piece with a lemon slice, from 1 lemon cut into 10 slices.
Bake for 30 minutes, until golden brown and the juices run clear.
Heat the oven to 400 °F.
Place 1 pound of halibut fillet in the center of a baking pan.
Drizzle the fish with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1/4 cup of fish stock.
Add 4 sprigs of thyme and the slices of 1 lemon on top of the fish.
Sprinkle the fish with 1 tablespoon of black pepper.
Cover the pan with parchment paper and foil.
Bake on a sheet pan for 15 minutes, until the flesh is flaky.
steps.spoken: Bake on a sheet pan for 15 to twenty minutes, until the flesh is flaky.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Let’s Make Meatless Meals, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix 1 cup of lentils, 3/4 cup of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in a bowl.
Mix in 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of garlic powder.
Mix in 1/2 cup of chopped onion and 1 can of tomatoes.
Place the mixture in a 2 quart casserole dish.
Cover the dish tightly with a lid or foil.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and stir in 2 thinly sliced carrots.
Cover the dish and bake for 30 more minutes.
Remove the cover and sprinkle 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese on top.
Bake uncovered for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Peel 2 ripe bananas.
Mash the bananas in a bowl, not too finely.
Mix in 1 cup of oatmeal.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of cinnamon and 1 tablespoon of honey, if you like.
Line an oven tray with parchment paper.
Form discs of the mix about 3 inches wide on the tray.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the outside is golden and slightly crispy.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 20 minutes, until the outside is golden and slightly crispy. Use the rotating heat setting if your oven has one.

steps.instruction: Eat the cookies warm or cold.
steps.spoken: Eat the cookies warm or cold. They can be kept a couple of days in a sealed container.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 300 °F.
Peel and chop 1 small onion into small pieces.
Drain the liquid from 2 cups of cooked kidney beans.
Mix 2 cups of cooked rice, the onion and the beans in a bowl.
Put 8 flour tortillas on a flat surface.
Put 1/2 cup of the rice and bean mix in the middle of each tortilla.
Fold the sides of each tortilla over the filling.
Put each burrito in a baking pan.
Bake the burritos for 15 minutes.
Grate 1/2 cup of cheese while the burritos bake.
Pour 1/2 cup of salsa over the baked burritos.
Top the burritos with the cheese.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Family Fun, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Team Nutrition

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 4 eggs, 2 tablespoons of frozen corn and 1 tablespoon of milk to a large bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons green pepper, 1/4 cup onion and 1 tablespoon tomatoes.
Add 1 teaspoon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, hot pepper sauce and salt.
Blend for 1 minute, until the eggs are smooth.
Pour the egg mixture into a 9-by-9-inch dish lightly coated with cooking oil.
Cover the dish with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the eggs are set and thoroughly cooked.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-five minutes, until the eggs are set and thoroughly cooked.

steps.instruction: Wrap the tortillas in plastic.
Microwave the wrapped tortillas for 20 seconds, until warm.
steps.spoken: Microwave the wrapped tortillas for 20 seconds, until warm. Be careful when unwrapping them. The steam can be hot.

steps.instruction: Cut the baked egg mixture into 4 equal pieces.
Roll 1 piece of cooked egg in each tortilla.
Top each burrito with 2 tablespoons of salsa.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Sauté 1 small chopped onion in 1/2 stick of margarine over medium heat.
Mix 1/2 cup of uncooked rice and 1 can of beef consommé in a baking dish.
Pour the onion and margarine over the rice mixture and mix.
Cover the dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Take the dish out and add 1/2 can of water over the rice mixture.
Cover the dish and cook for 30 more minutes.

creamy-squash-soup-apples.title: Creamy Squash Soup with Shredded Apples

ingredients.name: frozen pureed winter (butternut) squash, 16 ounces each
apples, such as Golden Delicious or Gala

steps.instruction: Place the 2 boxes of frozen squash in a microwave-safe dish and cover it loosely.
Microwave on medium power for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Microwave on medium power for 5 to ten minutes, until the squash is mostly thawed.

steps.instruction: Peel 2 medium apples and shred them with a grater or food processor.
steps.spoken: Peel 2 medium apples and shred them with a grater or food processor. Or chop them finely into thin strips.

steps.instruction: Set aside 1/4 cup of the shredded apples.
Warm 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add all but 1/4 cup of the apples to the pan.
steps.spoken: Add all but 1/4 cup of the apples to the pan. Add the apples and cook and stir for about 5 minutes, until they soften.

steps.instruction: Stir in the thawed squash and 1/2 teaspoon of pumpkin pie spice.
Add 2 cans of evaporated milk, about 1/2 cup at a time, stirring after each.
Season with 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Cook and stir over high heat just until the soup is about to boil.
Ladle into bowls and top each with 1 tablespoon of the saved apples.
steps.spoken: Ladle into bowls and top each with 1 tablespoon of the saved apples. Ladle the soup into bowls. Top each with a tablespoon of the apples you set aside. Sprinkle with more pumpkin pie spice if you like.

source.credit: US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), 5 A Day for Better Health Program

ingredients.name: green peppers, chopped (or red, yellow or orange peppers)

steps.instruction: Wash all of the vegetables.
Put 4 cups of spinach and 4 cups of romaine lettuce in a large mixing bowl.
Add 2 cups of chopped green peppers and 2 cups of cherry tomatoes.
Add 1 cup each of chopped broccoli and chopped cauliflower.
Add 1 cup each of sliced yellow squash and sliced cucumber.
Add 2 cups of chopped carrot and 1 cup of sliced zucchini.
Mix the vegetables together.
Top with the nonfat or low-fat dressing of your choice.
Rinse 7 ounces of green lentils well and drain them.
Put the lentils in a pot with 4 cups of water.
Bring the lentils to a boil.
Boil gently for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil gently for 15 to twenty minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the lentils.
Add 1 3/4 ounces of vermicelli to the pot.
Add 1 teaspoon of curry powder and 1/2 teaspoon of paprika.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon of ground sumac.
Add 1 1/2 to 2 teaspoons of salt and a little ground black pepper.
Add 2 cups of boiling water.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Beat 4 eggs, 1/2 cup of sugar and 1 pinch of salt until frothy.
Mix 3/4 cup of flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder and the zest of 1 lemon.
Fold the flour mixture into the egg mixture.
Fold in 5 tablespoons of melted butter.
Divide the dough into greased madeleine molds.
steps.spoken: Divide the dough into greased madeleine molds. The dough will rise in the oven to fill the molds.

steps.instruction: Bake for 12 minutes, until the cakes are springy but not browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to fifteen minutes, until the cakes are springy but not browned.

steps.instruction: Let the madeleines cool.
Unmold the madeleines.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth, 14 1/2 ounces
low-sodium red kidney beans, 15 ounces each

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a 12-inch pan over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of onion pieces to the pan.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of onion pieces to the pan. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pieces begin to soften but not brown.

steps.instruction: Dice 1 cup of green bell pepper into 1/4-inch pieces.
steps.spoken: Dice 1 cup of green bell pepper into pieces about 1/4 inch in size. Slice it into 1/4-inch strips, hold the strips together, and cut across.

steps.instruction: Add the pepper to the onion and cover the pan.
steps.spoken: Add the pepper to the onion and cover the pan. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 1/2 teaspoons of cumin and 1 1/2 teaspoons of oregano.
steps.spoken: Add 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 1/2 teaspoons of cumin and 1 1/2 teaspoons of oregano. Cook and stir for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of broth and 1/2 cup of instant brown rice.
steps.spoken: Add 1 can of broth and 1/2 cup of instant brown rice. Stir well, cover the pan, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse 2 cans of kidney beans thoroughly.
Add the beans to the pan.
steps.spoken: Stir well and cover the pan. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat the beans and blend the flavors.

source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Stay Young At Heart

ingredients.name: egg yolks, beaten (or 1/3 cup egg substitute)

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 325 °F.
Spray a 1-quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, stir 1 cup of mashed sweet potato and 1/2 cup of mashed banana.
Add 1 cup of evaporated skim milk and blend well.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of brown sugar, 2 beaten egg yolks and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Move the sweet potato mixture to the casserole dish.
Combine 1/4 cup of raisins, 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Sprinkle the raisin mixture over the top of the sweet potato mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes, until a knife near the center comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 40 to forty-five minutes, until a knife stuck in near the center comes out clean.
